case.question: I fish from the pier for salmon. For this week, how good do you expect pier fishing for salmon to be at each of St. Joseph, South Haven, Grand Haven and Muskegon? Rate each port 0-4 (0 slow, 1 below average, 2 average, 3 good, 4 excellent) and say which you'd go to.

events.text:
## Recommendation
- **Go to St. Joseph's pier first.** Expect a slow, below-average evening at best. It's the only one of the four with a recent report of salmon caught at the pier heads.
- **Skip the Grand Haven and Muskegon piers this week.** Both had slow pier reports on the most recent weeks.
- **If you can get out, a boat is the better bet.** South Haven boats had the strongest recent results, with spoons and flies.
- **Check the pier and wind again before you go.** The newest report is six days old, and the water conditions I have are from the week before today, not live.

## Why
- St. Joseph is my pick because the Sept 14 St. Joseph report had boats catching a couple of coho and Chinook at the pier heads, the only pier-area catch I found for any of the four ports.
- I'd expect Grand Haven and Muskegon to stay slow because the Sept 14 and Sept 7 Grand Haven reports both called the pier slow, and the Sept 7 Muskegon report found no salmon at the breakwalls.
- I'd expect South Haven to be only fair from the pier because no recent report covers its pier, but its boats did well (Sept 7 rated good), and its last-3-day upwelling wind was the strongest of the four.
- Water near 70-71 F is warm for salmon, so I'd expect the fish to sit deeper than the pier reaches, which keeps pier catches low.

## Evidence
**Recent reports (Sept 14 and Sept 7 bulletins, salmon only)**
- Grand Haven pier: "The pier action was slow for salmon." (Grand Haven, 2022-09-14; quality 0). Same wording on 2022-09-07.
- Muskegon pier: "No salmon were reported from the breakwalls." (Muskegon, 2022-09-07; quality 0). No pier entry in the Sept 14 Muskegon report.
- St. Joseph: "There were a couple of boats fishing the pier heads and caught a couple of coho and Chinook." (St. Joseph, 2022-09-14; quality 1, boat). No pier-specific salmon rating.
- South Haven: no pier entry in either recent report. Boats: "Salmon anglers reported pretty good fishing this week… Fish were caught on spoons, rotators and flies." (South Haven, 2022-09-07; quality 3). Sept 14 boat rating was 2 (average).
- Boat depths for context: Grand Haven 55-110 ft down in 120-210 ft of water (2022-09-14, quality 3). Muskegon 55-100 ft down in 100-200 ft (2022-09-14, quality 1).

**Past seasons (matched on surface temperature, ~71 F)**
- The only matches were the same Sept 7 and Sept 14, 2022 reports. I found no earlier-season pier data to add.

**Conditions (week before today, backtest summary; not live)**
- Buoy surface water: about 70-71 F at all four ports, flat over the week.
- Upwelling wind (N-E, 8+ mph) in the last 3 days: South Haven 14 h, Muskegon 10 h, St. Joseph 8 h, Grand Haven 8 h.
- Surface water near the piers (satellite): 71 F at St. Joseph and South Haven, 71 F at Grand Haven and Muskegon, with no change in the last 3 days.
- General guidance (NY DEC): Chinook and coho prefer 52-58 F, so at these temperatures the fish are likely deeper than the pier.

**Ratings (pier, this week)**
- St. Joseph: 1 (below average). Based on the boat-at-pier-heads report.
- South Haven: 1 (inferred, no pier report). My estimate, not a reported rating.
- Grand Haven: 0 (slow). Based on two slow pier reports.
- Muskegon: 0 (slow). Based on the Sept 7 breakwall report.

## Caveats
- The newest report is from Sept 14, six days old, and the conditions I have are from the week before today. Treat these ratings as a guide and check live conditions before going.
- The pier ratings rely on very few reports. St. Joseph's 1 is based on a single boat-at-pier-heads line, and South Haven's 1 is my estimate with no pier report.
- Water temperatures are measured by buoys and satellite and are not modeled pierhead values; I didn't have a live modeled pierhead reading.

## Sources
- DNR report, Sept 14, 2022 (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/32cff90
- DNR report, Sept 7, 2022 (Grand Haven, Muskegon, South Haven, St. Joseph): https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/32bbcf0
